column3: nothing was declared, so nothing is known; the absence of a grant is not a grant and not a refusal either
the declaration points somewhere instead of saying something, and this workspace does not follow the pointer
the terms are the authors own and no reading of them has been recorded here, so the answer is that we do not know
the licence grants use of the work including its source, on terms this workspace can meet without asking
the grant carries an obligation to credit, which is a condition to satisfy rather than a permission already held
the grant carries conditions on distributing derived work, which have to be met before the source is used
the grant carries conditions that reach the whole derived work, which have to be met before the source is used
the author reserved every right, so no permission to read the source into a derived work exists to be relied on
the licence names the use as one it does not permit, and reimplementing from the source is that use
the licence permits the work generally and names competing with the licensor as the use it withholds, which is what a native reimplementation is
